about: The decision gate's answer key (R-394): the scenario and the call of each golden moment, read by Claude from Denning's notes, not from the drop-downs (R-341). Each part lists the engine words that agree with his notes; a part his notes leave open is not scored. t is when his notes put the decision (it can differ from the moment as first picked). Denning corrects any line here; his correction is filed as a ruling.
